# spectacular-charts

> Linked, crossfiltered charts for Python and Jupyter, described in JSON instead of plotting code. Install `spectacular-charts`, import `spectacular`. A description names columns; chart types are inferred from column types; brushing one chart filters the others; problems come back as {"path", "message"} pairs.

Start with the agent guide: it is complete on its own.

## For agents

- [spectacular-charts for AI agents](https://fullscreen-triangle.github.io/spectacular/for-ai/): the whole description language, inference rules, colours, recipes, errors and outputs on one page
- [Plain-text agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fullscreen-triangle/spectacular/rebuild/docs/for-ai.md): the same page as Markdown
- [Description keys](https://fullscreen-triangle.github.io/spectacular/reference/keys/): every key and alias the compiler accepts
- [View specs](https://fullscreen-triangle.github.io/spectacular/reference/spec/): the exact spec format descriptions compile to
- [Full specification for programs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fullscreen-triangle/spectacular/rebuild/spectacular-specifications.md): spec, commands, embedding, limits
